evals.prompt: Fix the duplicate gradient IDs when this inline SVG component appears twice; keep both accessible names.
evals.expected_output: A corrected component with isolated IDs and references per instance.
assertions: Updates url and ARIA references consistently.
Retains gradient appearance and contextual names.
Tests repeated instances in the host.

evals.prompt: 修改這個 SVG 圖示的鏤空形狀，保留尺寸與可編輯文字。
evals.expected_output: 保留文字與座標合約的 SVG 修訂及實際檢視結果。
assertions: 檢查 winding 與 fill-rule 對孔洞的影響。
不自動將文字轉成路徑或重畫品牌。
檢查小尺寸與放大後的鏤空和裁切。

evals.prompt: Make the color of an SVG loaded through img follow the button currentColor.
evals.expected_output: A working embedding solution with the accessibility contract retained.
assertions: Recognizes external image does not inherit host color like inline SVG.
Uses an appropriate inline or other deliberate solution within scope.
Checks resulting button sizing and naming.
